title: Guest (embed/share/SCIM) tokens carry a distinct ROLE_TOKEN_PRINCIPAL authority and every isFullyAuthenticated() fallback rule requires a real user, so a guest is confined by the URL rules even if a filter's URI-prefix check slips

criteria.given: the embed, share and SCIM filters that mint a PreAuthenticatedAuthenticationToken
criteria.then: each adds the ROLE_TOKEN_PRINCIPAL marker authority next to its specific guest role

criteria.given: the main security chain in applicationContext-saiku.xml (and the /xmla chain)
criteria.then: no intercept-url admits on a bare isFullyAuthenticated(): every such rule also excludes the TOKEN_PRINCIPAL marker, so the /embed/**, /share/**, /rest/** and /** fallbacks reject a guest
it exists and evaluates the real XML rules for an embed guest, a share guest and a real user
